queries.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT "MUNIC_RES", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ), uti_internacoes AS ( SELECT "MUNIC_RES", COUNT(*) AS total_uti FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES" ) SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, ROUND(COALESCE(ui.total_uti, 0) * 100.0 / ti.total, 2) AS proporcao, ti.total FROM total_internacoes ti JOIN municipios mu ON ti."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" LEFT JOIN uti_internacoes ui ON ti."MUNIC_RES" = ui."MUNIC_RES" GROUP BY mu."nome", ti.total, ui.total_uti ORDER BY proporcao DESC LIMIT 5;

queries.question: Quais são os 10 municípios do RS com taxa de mortalidade acima da média estadual (considerando apenas municípios com mais de 500 internações)?
queries.gold_sql: WITH media_rs AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_media FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS'), por_municipio AS (SELECT mu.nome, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) SELECT pm.nome, pm.total_internacoes, pm.taxa_mortalidade FROM por_municipio pm, media_rs mr WHERE pm.taxa_mortalidade > mr.taxa_media ORDER BY pm.taxa_mortalidade DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.question: Quais procedimentos, ordenados por volume decrescente, cobrem até 80% do total de atendimentos realizados?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT nome_proc FROM (SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS nome_proc, COUNT(*) AS total_atendimentos, ROUND(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_acumulado FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC") sub WHERE pct_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY total_atendimentos DESC;
queries.generated_sql: WITH total_atendimentos AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM atendimentos ), procedimentos_volume AS ( SELECT p."NOME_PROC", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN atendimentos a ON i."N_AIH" = a."N_AIH" JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ) SELECT pv."NOME_PROC", pv.total FROM procedimentos_volume pv JOIN total_atendimentos ta ON pv.total <= 0.8 * ta.total ORDER BY pv.total DESC;
